_comment: Camera-motion presets. Adding one = appending one object here. No code
change, no migration. Validated by zod at import (src/lib/presets.ts), so a
malformed entry fails at boot rather than silently vanishing from the picker.
`accent` drives the thumbnail gradient so the repo carries no binary assets.

presets.name: Dolly In
presets.description: Slow forward push. Perspective compresses as the subject grows in frame.
presets.promptFragment: slow dolly push-in on the subject, steadily deepening perspective compression

presets.name: Dolly Out
presets.description: Slow pull-back that reveals the environment around the subject.
presets.promptFragment: slow dolly pull-back, revealing the surrounding environment, subject receding into depth

presets.name: Crash Zoom
presets.description: Fast dolly-in with a zoom lens, ending locked on the subject.
presets.promptFragment: aggressive crash zoom whip into the subject, rapid dolly with zoom lens, settling hard on focus

presets.name: Orbit
presets.description: Camera arcs around a stationary subject, revealing its form in relief.
presets.promptFragment: smooth orbital arc around the subject, revealing its three-dimensional form, consistent radius

presets.name: FPV Drone
presets.description: First-person drone flight with banking turns and roll into frame.
presets.promptFragment: immersive first-person drone flight, banking roll through the scene, fast agile FPV movement with motion blur
presets.negativeFragment: static tripod shot, smooth gimbal steadiness

presets.name: Handheld
presets.description: Loose human operator grip. Subtle float, breathing micro-movement.
presets.promptFragment: shot handheld by an operator, subtle organic float and breathing micro-movement, imperfect human framing

presets.name: Tracking Shot
presets.description: Camera and subject move together, locked on one point through the frame.
presets.promptFragment: lateral tracking shot following the subject at constant distance, locked framing throughout, background parallax sliding past

presets.name: Rack Focus
presets.description: Focus pulls from foreground to background, holding both planes readable.
presets.promptFragment: shallow depth of field with a deliberate rack focus pulling from the foreground plane to the background subject, focus pull mid-shot

presets.name: Whip Pan
presets.description: Fast rotational whip between two subjects, heavy motion blur.
presets.promptFragment: whip pan rotating fast between two subjects, streaking horizontal motion blur, fast rotational camera movement

presets.name: Crane Up
presets.description: Camera rises vertically, opening the frame from intimate to wide.
presets.promptFragment: vertical crane shot rising smoothly, revealing the full scene from an intimate framing to a wide establishing view

presets.name: Bullet Time
presets.description: Time nearly stops; camera arcs around a frozen subject mid-motion.
presets.promptFragment: bullet-time shot, motion nearly frozen mid-action, camera arcing smoothly around the subject at high frame rate

presets.name: Static Lock-Off
presets.description: Locked tripod frame. All movement comes from the subject and lighting.
presets.promptFragment: locked-off tripod framing, entirely static camera, all motion occurring within the frame from the subject and shifting light
